communication_goal: 先记录复现步骤和环境，再开始修复。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer stands at the left holding one large smartphone upright at center with the full device border visible. The blank black phone screen contains only one simple unlabeled broken-line crack symbol near the middle, without letters or warning text. The hand grips the outer edge and does not cover the screen. The floating white OpenAI knot is at the right. No other devices.

coverage_review.scope: V027 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/V027.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅黑底白线插画，一个成年火柴人和一个 OpenAI 标识。竖直手机完整可见，屏幕裂纹是无文字的故障证据；复现、稳定和步骤仍由对白限定。
